name: [UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ Refabricated (26.3 R1)
description: An unofficial Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, based on upstream 1.1.8-hotfix. R1 for Minecraft 26.3 is the first build of the 26.3 line, ported from the 26.2 R3-hotfix2 source: it migrates the renderer to Mojang's RenderPearl backend (com.mojang.blaze3d.* -> com.mojang.renderpearl.*), follows vanilla's split of ItemInHandRenderer into FirstPersonHandsAndItems plus FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer, and updates the scope shaders to ShaderC #include. Compatibility integrations for REI, Zoomify and Shoulder Surfing Reloaded are DISABLED in this build because those mods have no Minecraft 26.3 release yet; they are not removed and return once upstream ships 26.3 builds. This release is verified to compile and pass the repository CI only - it has NOT been validated in-game, and the order-independent transparency (OIT) rework in 26.3 may affect scope masking, picture-in-picture optics, muzzle flash and translucent attachments. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team. The version keeps 1.1.8 as its SemVer core and uses '+fabric.26.3.R1' build metadata so existing gun-pack version requirements continue to work.
contributors: TACZ Dev Team (upstream Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero)
